title: Check yourself: helpers an interface keeps to itself

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Which Java release does this page credit with bringing in the private interface method?

options.says: The page credits Java 16 with records, not with private interface methods.
The page: Java 9 introduced the private interface method, allowing better encapsulation within interfaces.
The page names Java 9, not Java 8, as the release that introduced the private interface method.

concepts: Since Java 9 an interface can declare private methods to keep its helpers hidden.
